machine: epyc (dedicated single-tenant instance of the registry's epyc class; no co-tenant load)
cpu: AMD EPYC 7B13 (Milan), x86_64, 16 vCPU (8 cores x 2 threads), 1 socket, 32 MiB L3, 125 GiB RAM
toolchain: rustc/cargo 1.97.1, gcc 13.3.0, node v22.23.1, CPython 3.12.3 (+ cbor2 5.6.2 for the circuits reference checker)
protocol: 10 repeats per benchmark (+1 flagged warmup on produce); serial, one timed process at a time; dedicated box, load average snapshotted before/after every cell block

pinning.produce_and_geolog: unpinned (the driver and checker own the box; matches the incumbent re-conduct protocol, which ran under a multi-vCPU quota rather than a single-core mask)
pinning.gym_and_circuits: taskset core 15 (the registry epyc class's single-core wall protocol)
pinning.governor: cpufreq not exposed on this virtualized platform (no scaling_governor file); scheduler defaults

sibling_receipts.gymnasium: gymnasium/out/checker_receipts.epyc.json + checker_receipts_tt.epyc.json — fresh single-core sweeps of both tiers; the top-level host field is added by the producing run (the underlying driver does not record a machine field); verdicts, row counts, and bounds identical to the committed sweeps
sibling_receipts.circuits: circuits/out/recheck-times.epyc.json — reference-checker walls, batched per fixture class + whole-suite, 10 repeats
sibling_receipts.staged_lane: supermartingales/out/glc/GLC-TIMINGS.epyc.json — the staged-corpus recheck's per-machine timing receipt (fully green run: 464/464 + 4105/4105 + designed mutants in class)

notes: All produce repeats byte-identical to the committed containers (revision-event-5.1 vintage, MANIFEST.json hashes). Spread rule (max-min)/median > 0.25: one flag across all receipt sets - circuits class seven_seg at 0.275 (median 43.6 ms; absolute range 12 ms on an interpreter-startup-dominated cell); produce faulty_varying__last_step sits exactly at 0.250 (65 ms cell), boundary not exceeded. No GPU on this estate: no produce-gpu.json.
